canonical_policy: Human review projection generated from this local structured package; historical packages immutable; no runtime or approval inference.

architecture.system: Native operator/harness → approved product input boundaries → module usecases/domain → Ports ← native adapters; M08 observes read-only evidence.
architecture.dependency: M01–M07 runtime plus IO native capability + locked artifact → M08 integration acceptance. No ownership of module business state.
architecture.mutation: Only future run-owned disposable fixtures through approved product operations. No current launch/build/package/install/native mutation in this delivery.
architecture.transaction: Bind source+spec+artifact+environment → verify fixture ownership → run → record actual outcome → hash comparison → retain diagnostics → cleanup only owned disposable scope.
forbidden: lower-layer source/unit/probe evidence presented as native/full-system PASS
historical binary used as current phase1 artifact

responsiveness.requirement: 既有：快照寫入不應阻塞 UI 操作；下列數字是建議驗收預設，尚未採納為產品 SLA。

proposed_default.percentile: nearest rank sorted[ceil(0.95*N)-1]; integers in monotonic microseconds; bounds inclusive

responsiveness.interaction: Alternate selection between two pre-existing visible fixture objects through ordinary permitted native UI input. Expected acknowledgement is the visible selected-object identity/highlight matching that particular input. Selection must not count as content change; no destructive action or hidden UI evaluation.

GWT.Given: Eligible locked artifact, actual Windows11 x64, disposable owned project/account, native recording with calibrated monotonic event/frame mapping and an approved observable snapshot write interval
GWT.When: Issue30 alternating selection inputs over30seconds while an actual permitted snapshot write overlaps at least3 inputs
GWT.Then: Each input receives its matching acknowledgement; conservative p95 latency <=250ms and maximum <=1000ms; content/source hashes remain valid and no edit is silently marked captured

responsiveness.latency: ack_frame_end_us - issued_at_us, a conservative upper bound; use calibrated interval end, never subtract recorder uncertainty to turn a failure into PASS. Wrong object/missing acknowledgement by maximum deadline fails responsiveness; missing or invalid recording is not product RED.
observation_health: Run/PID/start/executable hash bind input trace, recording and write interval to the same session
All30 inputs and matching acknowledgements accounted for, unless a timed-out acknowledgement is the actual measured product failure
Monotonic ordering, calibration uncertainty <=20000us, no dropped/unbounded frames, exact native write interval start/end evidence
At least3 issued inputs are within a proven write interval; at least1 still-pending content edit is checked through approved M07 observation after capture without adding new hook
fixture_recipe: Only approved disposable data and permitted material sizes; use current M05/M07 accepted limits, not an invented large-asset cap
Use an eligible real write and ordinary native input. If permitted workload finishes too quickly for3 overlaps, report BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_OVERLAP; do not stall product IO or add sleeps/hooks

If M07 cannot expose approved write/capture acknowledgement evidence, classify IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED/ARCHITECTURE_GAP for native execution and propose observability separately. Do not implement a test hook in this package
Record the actual permissible workload, hashes and native environment. Do not benchmark old historical binary or call a library timer/native probe full UI evidence

classification.measured_all_thresholds_and_health_met: eligible native operator may report PASS only after separate native harness approval; this planning file is NOT RUN
classification.bad_calibration_or_wrong_process_or_miss: BLOCKED_OBSERVATION; no native PASS/FAIL or valid RED inferred
classification.synthetic_unit_metric_vector: SCHEMA/METRIC ORACLE ONLY, never native responsiveness proof

forbidden: new production UI control or runtime Port
private JS/DOM injection to simulate acknowledgement
process-name kill or changing real user project/profile
deriving capture success from UI selection state
responsiveness.integration_boundary: M08 records evidence; M03 owns UI/preview authority and M07 owns writer/capture/baselines. This proposal does not move ownership or alter60-second snapshot cadence.
responsiveness.owner_decision: M08-PD1: adopt or adjust the numeric responsiveness acceptance profile and native observation strategy as a whole; not yet approved.
responsiveness.proposed_metric_signature: _evaluate_responsiveness_profile(latencies_upper_bound_us: Sequence[int], observation_health: Mapping[str, JSONValue], profile: ResponseProfile) -> ResponsivenessCheck
responsiveness.proposed_metric_output: frozen ResponsivenessCheck(classification: declared metric-vector code, p95_us:int|None, maximum_us:int|None, evidence_scope:Literal[SCHEMA_UNIT]); never returns native PASS
responsiveness.pure_metric_precedence: Reject malformed samples/clock/run identity or count first, then insufficient overlap, then max over1000000us, then p95 over250000us, else WITHIN_PROPOSED_PROFILE. Wrong/missing native acknowledgement is a separate measured failure in the operator assertion, not silently removed from the30-event denominator.

validator.entry_signature: _validate_evidence_claim(record: Mapping[str, JSONValue], observed_bindings: Mapping[str, JSONValue], case_policy: Mapping[str, JSONValue]) -> EvidenceCheck

local_types.JSONValue: None | bool | int | str | list[JSONValue] | dict[str, JSONValue]; float not used for digests/PIDs/time samples
local_types.EvidenceIssue: frozen dataclass(code: EvidenceCode, pointer: RFC6901 absolute string)
local_types.EvidenceCheck: frozen dataclass(classification: Literal[SCHEMA_VALID, REJECTED], issue: EvidenceIssue | None, evidence_scope: Literal[SCHEMA_UNIT]); never returns PASS or native verdict

preconditions: All three inputs borrowed read-only, no mutation or normalization
observed_bindings.mode must be SCHEMA_UNIT for this first pure slice; fixture facts are synthetic test doubles
No native collector, PID lookup, filesystem hashing, process launch, file write, network or live aggregation capability in this slice
postconditions: SCHEMA_VALID iff all declared structural/cross-field checks pass against supplied facts; NOT proof those facts physically exist
REJECTED has exactly the first declared EvidenceIssue; stable priority below, no assertion weakening
Inputs remain deeply/canonically equal before and after both success and error
No native/system PASS can be produced by this return type or incorporated as actual evidence

checks: record format/module/case shape; RFC3339 timestamp includes timezone; hash/PID primitive syntax
priority_groups.tie_break: schema property order from existing record-fields.json, then RFC6901 index order

checks: required nonempty valid source inventory hash
required build manifest source reference and manifest SHA
actual artifact SHA equals manifest executable SHA and supplied expected artifact binding
canonical root ownership proof for each root, not caller boolean or path prefix
E0/E1/E2 cannot satisfy native-layer required case
profile and source-preservation requirements from case policy

validator.non_PASS_records: NOT RUN/BLOCKED record may retain truthful read-only artifact identification, but cannot invent PID/start/result/capture. Validate present fields, shape and truthful missing prerequisite representation; do not require an executable or Win11 to validate its schema.
validator.timestamp_rule: RFC3339 timezone Z or explicit offset required; date/time/offset validity checked, no locale parsing. Missing timezone has specific E_TIMESTAMP_OFFSET_REQUIRED.
validator.source_inventory_rule: Missing, null or empty /source/dirty_inventory_sha256 receives E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED before generic digest-shape validation; present wrong-length/case token receives E_DIGEST_FORMAT.
validator.PID_rule: EXECUTED requires type exactly int (bool is not int here), 1 <= pid <= 4294967295; reject0/negative/out-of-range without touching OS.
validator.source_truth_boundary: Supplied bindings do not establish authenticity. A later separately designed/approved native runner must acquire actual observations and own aggregation. No untrusted record can grant itself authority by setting eligibility, root boolean, illustrative flag or PID.
validator.runtime_aggregation: OUT_OF_SCOPE; no native PASS result type/function in H1

applicability.all_records: mode guard, closed shape, required source identity syntax, timestamp and every present field type; output always SCHEMA_UNIT
applicability.non_PASS_records: may remain truthfully BLOCKED without Win11/eligible artifact/owned native fixture; NOT RUN state requires pid/start/selected path null, no operation_result or captures; surplus process fields use E_UNEXECUTED_PROCESS_FIELDS, captures use E_UNEXECUTED_CAPTURE
applicability.executed_failure_records: retain actual provided process identity/evidence when known; require supplied binding consistency without treating it as a PASS; no facts invented for a missing prerequisite

shape_policy.closed_objects: top-level and each named source/artifact/environment/execution/fixture/evidence/result object reject unknown fields; operation_result is explicitly free JSON scalar/object/null, source-hash maps use fixture-relative IDs
shape_policy.required: all original record-fields.json keys are required, except specifically nullable fields still require the key

error_mapping.missing_key: E_FIELD_REQUIRED at exact missing pointer, with source inventory special case E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED

shape_policy.specific_primitive_precedence: format/PID/digest/source inventory/timestamp specialized errors precede generic type check at that same field; missing source inventory always uses E_SOURCE_INVENTORY_REQUIRED
shape_policy.maps_and_refs: original_source_hashes_before_after requires per-fixture {before:64hex,after:64hex}; capture refs are opaque lookup keys resolved only against supplied capture_bindings, never file-opened
shape_policy.array_order: record arrays retained; issues chosen by stable priority, then documented field/index order; no mutation/default-filling

validator.deterministic_order_note: All vector fields not explicitly mutated retain valid base values. N05 execution-state priority precedes NOT RUN extraneous PID checks; N06 missing manifest precedes artifact/binding checks; N08 process identity precedes capture consistency. Return one stable first issue, never mask a higher-priority mismatch.
